item.title: Life's missing white space
item.author: massimo.nocentini@gmail.com (Massimo Nocentini)
item.description: Leo Babauta applies the design principle of white space to everyday life, arguing that leaving room between tasks, possessions, and commitments creates clarity, peace, balance, and greater attention to what matters most. The text proposes a practical path of simplification through breathing, lighter schedules, fewer simultaneous projects, less clutter, and a slower, more deliberate way of living.
